context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 Service Enhancements complete. Service edit dialog has all new fields: Category (with autocomplete from existing categories), Duration, Price, Buffer (min), Visible Online toggle, Require Deposit toggle (shows Deposit Amount field when enabled), Assigned Staff section with pill-button UI (click to toggle staff on/off), Add-Ons section (name/price/duration with + button to add). Backend ServiceBase model supports: category, buffer_time, deposit_required, deposit_amount, visible_online, staff_ids (list), add_ons (list of {name, price, duration}). All CRUD operations work via POST/PUT/DELETE /api/services.
